archetypes.name: dyn-hook-correctness
archetypes.rationale: New hook script uses bash subshell and marker-liveness logic; verify edge cases around marker PID check, timeout, and sentinel release
archetypes.prompt_body: Review hook-no-progress-guard.sh for correctness: PID liveness check (`kill -0`), timeout arithmetic, CLAUDE_PID scoping, and the `is_step_completed` sentinel check. Verify the counter_bump atomic write pattern handles concurrent invocations (multiple hooks firing). Check the event-type detection fallback logic for correctness when `event_type` key is absent. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
